global_identity.color_palette: Warm cream background #FBF3DC fading softly to a slightly deeper warm cream-beige toward the lower third; near-black #111111 for all text; lemon yellow #F2DC4A and metallic gold #C9A441 only as small accents inside the photos (a mug, a towel, a bottle cap) and on the product label; amber brown #8A4B14 (bottle glass); soft white #FFFFFF highlights.
global_identity.visual_style: Clean, bright beauty-supplement ad. Plain text layout plus two natural, casual smartphone photos. The woman is shown from the waist up, fully dressed, never as a body close-up.
global_identity.visual_atmosphere: Light, warm, feminine, honest and trustworthy; soft diffused daylight, no harsh shadows.
global_identity.graphic_language: Flat cream canvas with a soft vertical gradient, no panels and no decorations; two rectangular photos with square corners stacked with a thin cream gap; soft contact shadow under the product.
global_identity.text_typography: All copy in a clean geometric sans-serif, regular weight, sentence case, centered, solid near-black, comfortable line spacing. One single line in extra-bold geometric sans, sentence case, clearly larger. No uppercase headline, no outlines and no drop shadows on the text.

creative_objective: Disarm the woman who already bought gummies and pills and saw nothing by agreeing with her doubt first: this is not magic, it is a daily ritual that goes with food and exercise. Preserve the exact structure of the source: a left column with a long centered confessional text, a four-bullet list, a closing paragraph, one bold line and the large bottle underneath; a right column with two casual phone photos stacked one above the other. The photos show the ritual (her drops and breakfast, her gym routine), never a body comparison.

art_direction.design_quality: Premium, polished, modern, scroll-stopping, professionally designed, commercially strong
art_direction.visual_hierarchy: 1) The two stacked casual photos on the right, which look like real content. 2) The first line of the long text on the left. 3) The bold line and the large bottle at the bottom left. 4) The bullet list and the closing paragraph.
art_direction.composition_style: Two columns. Left column (about 4% to 46% of the width): centered text stacked from top to bottom, then the bold line, then the bottle. Right column (about 48% to 96% of the width): two equal rectangular photos stacked vertically with a thin gap, filling almost the full height.
art_direction.spacing_and_structure: Top margin about 8% left empty as plain background. Opening paragraph y 9-21%, bullet list y 23-36%, closing paragraph y 38-55%, bold line y 57-62%, bottle y 63-96%. Right photos: top photo y 8-51%, bottom photo y 52-96%. Even line spacing; small gaps separate the three text groups.
art_direction.lighting_and_depth: Flat cream gradient canvas. The photos have natural indoor light and a casual smartphone look. The bottle is rendered photorealistically with soft studio light and a soft contact shadow.
art_direction.conversion_feel: The ad must feel persuasive, eye-catching, emotionally engaging, credible, elegant and commercially strong

visual_prompt: Square 1:1 static ad on a warm cream background (#FBF3DC) with a soft vertical gradient that gets slightly deeper cream-beige toward the lower third. The top 8% of the canvas is empty plain background. The layout has two columns. LEFT COLUMN (from 4% to 46% of the width), everything centered in the column, all text in a clean geometric sans-serif, regular weight, sentence case, solid near-black (#111111): first, an opening paragraph of four short lines; a small gap; then a list of four single lines, each starting with a small round dot bullet; a small gap; then a closing paragraph of seven short lines; a small gap; then ONE line of plain text in extra-bold weight, clearly larger than the rest, with no button, no box and no underline. Directly below the bold line, at the bottom of the left column, the product stands large, front view, at eye level, about 32% of the canvas height, with a soft contact shadow, its base near the bottom edge. RIGHT COLUMN (from 48% to 96% of the width): two rectangular photos with square corners, the same size, stacked one above the other with a thin cream gap between them, together filling from 8% to 96% of the height. Both are casual, slightly imperfect smartphone photos, eye-level, home-style framing, natural light, of the same Colombian woman of about 26 with long dark-brown hair in a ponytail, shown from the waist up and fully dressed. TOP PHOTO: she is in her kitchen in the morning, wearing a loose cream t-shirt, smiling softly at the camera, holding a small amber glass dropper bottle with a black dropper cap near her chest; on the counter beside her a served breakfast (a plate with arepa, scrambled eggs and fruit) and a glass of orange juice; a lemon-yellow mug in the background. BOTTOM PHOTO: a mirror selfie in a gym, the same woman with the same body, wearing a modest cream athletic t-shirt, holding her phone at chest height in one hand and a lemon-yellow water tumbler in the other, relaxed and proud expression, gym equipment softly out of focus behind her. The two photos are two moments of the same day, not a before and after: her body shape and size are identical in both. No text inside the photos. THE PRODUCT in the left column is a 60 ml (2 fl oz) amber-brown glass dropper bottle with rounded shoulders and a short neck, topped with a black ribbed screw collar and a glossy black rubber bulb dropper; the glass pipette is visible inside the amber liquid. A wraparound label covers most of the body with a smooth vertical gradient from bright lemon yellow at the top to white / pale silver at the bottom. On the label, from top to bottom: the lowercase black wordmark 'amua', the large white uppercase name 'VITALDROPS', a small dark line 'All-In-One Multi-Herbal Supplement', five small thin-outlined circular ingredient badges in two rows (A, MA, L on the first row; F, BR on the second) with tiny captions, and 'Dietary Supplement 2 fl. oz. (60mL)' at the bottom. The bottle is roughly 2.6 times taller than wide including the dropper. Use the attached product image as the only source of truth for the product; do not redesign, replace or reinterpret the bottle or its label. No logo at the top, no price, no button, no badges, no stars, no icons, no extra text.
